modules.module_title: Install aluminium doors, windows, glass door/window panels and decorative molding

pcs.pc_description: apply flexible waterproof flashing to the sides of bare wall surfaces along the frames as per applicable
check the frame is plumb, square and not twisted between the openings
check the inner frame and associated hardware for defects and take appropriate corrective measures
check for and clear any blockage in the weep holes in the inner frames to allow discharge of incidental water before the installation
follow the recommended sequence of panel installation
check the labels on the glass panels against the panel fixing plan and schedule
follow the standard orientation of glass panels for the consistent positioning of logos/trademarks
check the gasket for physical damages and take appropriate corrective measures
ensure the gasket is free from dust and dirt to ensure a good grip onto the frame and beadings
check the profile of gaskets is compatible with that of the beads used to secure the glass panels
insert glass panel into the frame for doors and windows and hold it in place using spacer hooks
splice gasket to fit around corners of the glass panes and secure it using appropriate tools and beading
seal the gap between the gasket and beading using an appropriate sealant, using suitable masking tape to protect glass during sealant application
install the decorative molding around the door/window frame as per specification
check the miter joints are flat and square at corners
check for even contact between the door/window face and the weather tripping attached to the frame
carry out insulation around doors/windows as per the specification
